text:
sam: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/18999 - streaming-client: backpressure handling. CI failing on mac-smoke & windows-e2e snapshots. Need quick eyes and approve for targeted rerun.
emily: Which tests exactly? mac logs?
sam: Failing test: TestStreamChunking_Smoke (only on mac-smoke shard 2) and windows-e2e: test_stream_integration::close_on_incomplete
Log snippet:
```text
--- FAIL: TestStreamChunking_Smoke
streamer/chunker.go:128: Stream closed: incomplete-chunk
stack: streamer/chunker.go:128 streamer/handler.go:78
```
prateek: CI bot shows mac shard2, windows shard7. If nondet snapshots, do targeted rerun on those shards, otherwise bisect. Try local repro: 
```bash
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/src redwood/ci:latest bash -c "go test ./streamer -run TestStreamChunking_Smoke -count=10"
```
ci-bot: Build 1876543210 - mac-smoke shard 2 FAILED (TestStreamChunking_Smoke) ; windows-e2e shard 7 FLAKY - snapshot mismatch. See: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1876543210
nora: @sam can you mark this as merge-blocker? we have a 2pm merge window in 45m. Otherwise we should hold the merge.
emily: If it's only snapshot noise, update snapshot with a deterministic fix. If it's environmental, skip with // flaky on mac only and add ticket to root cause.
sam: I can do a quick change to add a guarded skip for darwin and open a follow-up. Prefer not to update snapshot blind. Will push change and request targeted rerun. @prateek can you approve after quick review?
prateek: :eyes: I'll skim now. If it's a skip behind a flag + issue link I'm fine with approving.
sam: Pushed: short skip with TODO + issue 4231. PR updated and requesting targeted rerun for shards [mac-smoke:2, windows-e2e:7].
prateek: LGTM. :thumbsup: approving now.
ci-bot: Triggered targeted rerun for shards [2,7] by sam.
sam: Thanks all. If rerun passes I'll merge and open ticket to investigate chunking edge-case. If fails, we'll bisect tomorrow.
